card.title: How To Fix an iPhone 7 That Is Randomly Restarting

source.title: How To Fix an iPhone 7 That Is Randomly Restarting

claims.statement: iPhone 7 restarting every 3 minutes with erratic battery %, Service in Battery Health and no battery data cannot talk to the battery over TIGRIS_BATTERY_SWI_CONN; panic logs show Missing sensors TG0B.
Most often the battery connector's centre pins are pushed in or the connector is damaged; otherwise Tigris, Tristar or a line under them is at fault.

procedure: Confirm TG0B in the panic log.
Inspect/realign battery connector centre pins or replace the connector.
Diode-check pads under Tigris and Tristar for shorts/opens and trace them.
Test with a stopwatch beyond 3 min, a long video and USB charge current.
card.caveats: Community-written Repair Wiki page, paraphrased; check the linked page (and its images) before acting on a reading.
